concepts.title: Constant acceleration
concepts.description: A motion model in which acceleration remains constant over the interval being studied.
concepts.subject: physics

concepts.title: Displacement under constant acceleration
concepts.description: The change in position over a time interval, computed from the initial velocity and constant acceleration.
concepts.subject: physics

concepts.title: Final velocity under constant acceleration
concepts.description: The velocity at the end of a time interval when the initial velocity and constant acceleration are known.
concepts.subject: physics
